facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident - pressure exposure at P-4102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-4102, ACC-4102 and HX-4120 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-4102, ACC-4102 and HX-4120 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4102 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 10 March 2023 a high potential incident was recorded on P-4102, ACC-4102 and HX-4120 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during transfer operations; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
